'''{{PAGENAME}}''' was a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Come on in, sit down. Tea's almost ready, it'll warm you up. We haven't had such temperatures since 1873. That winter was as tough as this one, I even warmed up a stray fox here! It makes a big difference in a combat situation. You can freeze your fingers so cold that you can't even pull the trigger. Can't sit in an ambush either when you're freezing cold. If you want to survive, you gotta toughen up your body. Try to take out a few enemies when you're cold.}}

==Objectives==
* Eliminate any 10 targets while suffering from the Frostbite effect

==Rewards==
* +8,900 [[EXP]]
* [[Jaeger]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.02'''</font>
* 72,000 Roubles
** 75,600 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence center]] Level 1
** 82,800 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence center]] Level 2
* 4× [[Salewa first aid kit]]
{{quote|So how's your condition? Now you need to warm up, or you'll be out of commission for a week. After you're warmed up, you'll have to practice again, otherwise your body won't get used to it. Then the cold will be an advantage, not a setback.}}

==Guide==
In this quest you have to kill any 10 targets while being under the [[File:Frostbite.png|46px|Frostbite]] effect.

The effect is caused by being exposed to snowfall. It can be avoided in shelters, near firebarrels or with alchohol.

While the effect is active, the following debuffs apply:
* Hands tremor effect
* Decreases [[Endurance]] (<font color="red">-5</font>)
* Decreases energy recovery (<font color="red">-0.1</font>/s)
* Decreases hydration recovery (<font color="red">-0.1</font>/s)
* Decreases maximum stamina (<font color="red">-20</font>)
* Decreases stamina recovery rate (<font color="red">-1</font>/s)
* Lowers body temperature (<font color="red">-0.1 °C</font>/s) (minimum 28 °C)
